rows.col_1: Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is obtained via a three-legged OAuth flow.
The BIM 360 project ID. Must be a UUID or a project ID of the form “b.{UUID}”.

The request payload for updating an asset V2. The payload is a set of key:value pairs. The key is the
asset ID of the asset to revise. The value is a set of one or more asset attributes to revise.
Each attribute revision is itself a key:value pair. The key is the attribute name (one of the asset
fields supplied in a request to POST assets:batch-create V2).
The value is any permissible defined value for the field as described in POST assets:batch-create V2.
Successfully updated specified assets and returned properties of updated assets.
The request could not be understood by the server due to malformed syntax or missing request header
The request was not accepted because it lacked valid authentication credentials
The request was not accepted because the client is authenticated, but is not authorized to access the target resource
The request could not be completed due to a conflict with the current state of the target resource
The request was not accepted because the rate limit was exceeded due to too many requests being made.
An unexpected error occurred on the server

The response is a set of key:value pairs. The key is the asset ID of the asset that was revised. The
value is the fully revised asset.
